create_detection_model_loader: create a DetectionModelLoader instance with an optional checkpoint path for loading a detection model
build_detection_model: build an EfficientViTForSemanticSegmentation detection model from a pretrained checkpoint on a specified device and dtype
compile_detection_model: compile a detection model with torch.compile for accelerated inference on the target device
load_image_processor: load a SegformerImageProcessor from a pretrained checkpoint for preprocessing images before detection
test_detection_loader: test the DetectionModelLoader class and its model and processor methods with configurable device and dtype
